quick_start: Run pwd to see where you are.
Run ls or ls -F to inspect the room.
Run cat scroll to read room instructions.
Use cd <room> to move through the dungeon.

bashcrawl.title: THE LOBBY
bashcrawl.context_hint: You are in the main lobby. Type 'cd entrance' to begin your adventure.
bashcrawl.description: The main lobby — gateway to the catacombs

entrance.title: THE ENTRANCE HALL
entrance.context_hint: You stand at the entrance to the catacombs. Read the 'scroll' for guidance.
entrance.description: This is your starting point - learn basic navigation here

cellar.title: THE CELLAR
cellar.context_hint: You are in the underground cellar. Use ls -F to distinguish file types. Find the emerald!
cellar.description: Learn file types and basic interaction here
cellar.next_steps: Collect your first amulet, then explore armoury/

armoury.title: THE ARMOURY
armoury.context_hint: You have entered the armoury. Master chmod and ./script for combat!
armoury.description: Advanced area focusing on file permissions and combat
armoury.next_steps: Drink the potion, collect the sword, descend to chamber/

chamber.title: THE CHAMBER
chamber.context_hint: The treasure chamber! Run ./treasure, ./statue, or ./spell for rewards.
chamber.next_steps: Face the statue, then cast the spell to create a portal

workshop.title: THE WORKSHOP
workshop.context_hint: The workshop teaches creation: mkdir, touch, rm, echo >. Practice shaping the world!

chapel.title: THE CHAPEL
chapel.context_hint: Chapel path: Discover hidden commands and the ancient library tome.
chapel.description: A hidden sanctuary unlocked by collecting treasures — learn grep
chapel.next_steps: Explore the graveyard or continue to the courtyard

essential_commands.description: Search for text in a file

courtyard.title: THE COURTYARD
courtyard.context_hint: Chapel path: Discover hidden commands and the ancient library tome.
courtyard.description: An open area leading deeper into the castle — learn pipes

aviary.title: THE AVIARY
aviary.context_hint: Chapel path: Discover hidden commands and the ancient library tome.
aviary.description: A towering room filled with caged birds — learn output redirection

hall.title: THE GREAT HALL
hall.context_hint: Chapel path: Discover hidden commands and the ancient library tome.
hall.description: A grand hall connecting to the library — learn sorting and filtering

library.title: THE ANCIENT LIBRARY
library.context_hint: Chapel path: Discover hidden commands and the ancient library tome.
library.description: Deep within the chapel — learn self-teaching commands
teaches: The tome teaches random advanced tips
library.next_steps: Read the tome with ./tome — if you carry the right items, a secret may reveal itself

study.title: THE HIDDEN STUDY
study.context_hint: The study holds the grimoire. Run ./grimoire to open the portal.
study.description: Secret room behind the library bookshelf — learn shell functions
study.next_steps: Run ./grimoire to open the portal, then cd portal to reach the Scriptorium

graveyard.title: THE GRAVEYARD
graveyard.context_hint: The graveyard holds secrets. Use ls -a to find the hidden mausoleum.
graveyard.on_enter: A cold wind howls through the tombstones...
graveyard.description: A misty place beyond the chapel — learn find
teaches: Finding by name, type, and permissions
graveyard.next_steps: Search for hidden files and paths

columbarium.title: THE COLUMBARIUM
columbarium.context_hint: Study the niches carefully. Use grep and touch to solve the puzzle.
columbarium.description: Rows of burial niches with inscribed symbols
columbarium.next_steps: Solve the niche puzzle to find a padlock number

lower-quadrant.title: THE LOWER QUADRANT
lower-quadrant.context_hint: Sort the gravestones to find the year of death.
lower-quadrant.description: Weathered gravestones with dates and names
lower-quadrant.next_steps: Sort the gravestones to find a padlock number

royal-tombs.title: THE ROYAL TOMBS
royal-tombs.context_hint: Use grep to search the royals list for the crown placement.
royal-tombs.next_steps: Find the crown placement number for the padlock

mausoleum.title: THE MAUSOLEUM
mausoleum.context_hint: Use sort and uniq to find the unique line in the room file.
mausoleum.on_enter: The heavy stone door grinds open...
mausoleum.description: A hidden crypt behind the padlock
mausoleum.next_steps: Use sort room | uniq to find the chest combination

vault.title: THE VAULT
vault.context_hint: Vault path: Master variables, collect the goblet to unlock the Rift!
vault.description: A hidden vault — learn shell variables and environment

stronghold.title: THE STRONGHOLD
stronghold.context_hint: Vault path: Master variables, collect the goblet to unlock the Rift!
stronghold.description: Fortified area within the vault — goblet challenge unlocks the rift
stronghold.next_steps: Complete the goblet challenge to unlock the rift

nursery.title: THE NURSERY
nursery.context_hint: Vault path: Master variables, collect the goblet to unlock the Rift!
nursery.description: A quiet room within the vault complex — learn process management

lab.title: THE LABORATORY
lab.context_hint: Vault path: Master variables, collect the goblet to unlock the Rift!
lab.description: An alchemist's lab — learn process substitution and advanced piping
lab.next_steps: Apply your knowledge across the dungeon

scrap.title: THE SCRAP HEAP
scrap.context_hint: The Scrap teaches symlinks: ln -s creates portals. Find the path to the Rift!
scrap.description: A hidden directory teaching symbolic links

rift.title: THE RIFT
rift.context_hint: The Rift: Advanced challenges. Boss encounters in the Pit, secrets in the Spire!
rift.on_enter: Reality shimmers and tears apart before you...
rift.description: A dimensional tear — advanced scripting and checksums
rift.next_steps: Explore the arena or ascend the spire

arena.title: THE ARENA
arena.context_hint: The Rift: Advanced challenges. Boss encounters in the Pit, secrets in the Spire!
arena.description: A battle zone within the rift — learn loops and iteration

essential_commands.command: for f in *; do echo $f; done

pit.title: THE PIT
pit.context_hint: The Rift: Advanced challenges. Boss encounters in the Pit, secrets in the Spire!
pit.on_enter: The ground gives way beneath your feet...
pit.description: The deepest point of the arena — learn error handling
pit.next_steps: Emerge victorious with mastery of error handling

spire.title: THE SPIRE
spire.context_hint: The Rift: Advanced challenges. Boss encounters in the Pit, secrets in the Spire!
spire.description: A tower rising from the rift — learn text processing

mezzanine.title: THE MEZZANINE
mezzanine.context_hint: The Rift: Advanced challenges. Boss encounters in the Pit, secrets in the Spire!
mezzanine.description: An elevated platform within the spire — learn advanced regex
mezzanine.next_steps: Master regex patterns to complete the dungeon

unknown.title: UNKNOWN TERRITORY
unknown.context_hint: You're in an uncharted area! Use pwd to find your location.
teaches: Use navigation commands to orient yourself
unknown.next_steps: Use pwd to find your location, ls -la to explore

commands.description: Print Working Directory - shows your exact location
List files and directories in current location
List with type indicators: * = executable, / = directory, @ = link
List ALL files including hidden (.), with permissions and details
Display entire file contents at once
View file page by page (Space=next page, b=previous, q=quit)
Search for pattern in all files recursively

quests.title: Awakening: Know Thy Place
quests.description: You awaken in a strange dungeon. The air hums with arcane energy.
quests.objective: Cast the 'pwd' spell to reveal your place in the dungeon.
quests.hint: Type 'pwd' and press Enter to see your current chamber.

quests.title: Eyes to See
quests.description: The walls whisper: see what lies around you.
quests.objective: Use 'ls' to reveal nearby rooms and scrolls.
quests.hint: Try 'ls' to survey the room's contents.

quests.title: First Steps
quests.description: A dark passage leads deeper into the dungeon.
quests.objective: Use 'cd cellar' to descend into the cellar.
quests.hint: Use 'cd cellar' to descend into the cellar.

quests.title: Ancient Knowledge
quests.description: A dusty scroll rests on a stone pedestal.
quests.objective: Use 'cat scroll' to read the ancient knowledge.
quests.hint: Try 'cat scroll' to read the ancient knowledge on the pedestal.

quests.title: Shape the World
quests.description: The workshop calls — create something new.
quests.objective: Go up with 'cd ..', then 'cd workshop', then use 'mkdir <name>' to create a directory.
quests.hint: From the cellar, 'cd ..' returns to the entrance; then 'cd workshop', then 'mkdir forge'.

quests.title: Spark of Creation
quests.description: Your workspace yearns for a first artifact.
quests.objective: Use 'touch <filename>' to create a new file (for example 'touch notes.md').
quests.hint: Use 'touch notes.txt' to conjure a new file.

quests.title: Seek the Whisper
quests.description: Hidden phrases linger in old scrolls.
quests.objective: In a room that has a scroll (like the cellar), use 'grep <word> scroll' to search it for a word.
quests.hint: Run 'grep catacombs scroll' to uncover the hidden clue.

quests.title: The Bashcrawl Grimoire
quests.description: Deep in the chapel library, a tome of forgotten spells guards a secret.
quests.objective: Find the hidden study behind the library bookshelf, run the grimoire, and define the 'bc' command.
quests.hint: Find the library, read the tome, then source the grimoire.
quests.reward: 200 XP and the Scriptorium Key (permanent help system access)
quests.prerequisites: amulet and coins in inventory, tome read in library

glossary.definition: A folder that can contain files and other directories.
A text address for a file or directory.
A file or directory whose name starts with a dot.
A file you can run as a program, often shown with *.
A named value available to commands, like I or HP.
